#!/bin/bash\\n\\nBACKUP_DIR=\"/backup/my:
#!/bin/bash

BACKUP_DIR="/backup/mysql"
DATE=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
MYSQL_USER="root"
MYSQL_PASSWORD="password"

mkdir -p $BACKUP_DIR

echo "Starting database backup..."
mysqldump -u $MYSQL_USER -p$MYSQL_PASSWORD --all-databases | gzip > $BACKUP_DIR/backup_$DATE.sql.gz

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "✅ Backup succeeded: backup_$DATE.sql.gz"
  # Keep only the last 7 days of backups
  find $BACKUP_DIR -name "backup_*.sql.gz" -mtime +7 -delete
else
  echo "❌ Backup failed"
  exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash\\n\\necho \"=== Docker 资源清理:
#!/bin/bash

echo "=== Docker Resource Cleanup ==="

# Clean stopped containers
STOPPED=$(docker ps -aq -f status=exited | wc -l)
echo "Cleaning stopped containers: $STOPPED"
docker container prune -f

# Clean unused images
UNUSED=$(docker images -f "dangling=true" -q | wc -l)
echo "Cleaning unused images: $UNUSED"
docker image prune -f

# Clean unused volumes
VOLUMES=$(docker volume ls -qf dangling=true | wc -l)
echo "Cleaning unused volumes: $VOLUMES"
docker volume prune -f

echo "Cleanup complete!"
